editorial.quality_rationale: Category-relative very-good-at-its-purpose estimate: critics describe clean fruit-led rye character, pleasant sweetness and restrained spice, though the 93-proof, lightly aged standard expression lacks the length and layers of Sagamore's eight- and ten-year reserves. Batch variation limits precision.
editorial.quality_confidence: Medium for common core expression; independent general-expression reviews exist but the 20-barrel recipe may change per batch.
editorial.evidence_limit: Expert general-core reviews support style, not a guarantee every 20-barrel batch tastes identical; preserved Batch 2R sensory remains its own evidence.

serving.name: Neat
serving.recommendation: Start neat to establish the fruit-and-honey baseline with 93-proof accessibility and measure whether spice persists.

serving.name: Rocks
serving.recommendation: A single cube can work, though it will soften a comparatively light texture.

serving.name: Old Fashioned
serving.recommendation: An excellent practical Old Fashioned choice: moderate sweetness lets cherry/apple and baking spice remain visible.

serving.name: Manhattan
serving.recommendation: Strong general-purpose Manhattan component; dry vermouth choice and citrus bitters can emphasize underlying grain spice.

serving.name: Highball
serving.recommendation: Useful in a highball because the relatively modest price makes mixing less wasteful than with rare reserves.
